priority_1.workout_details:
- Warm-up: 5 mins dynamic mobility (hip openers, leg swings)
- Barbell Back Squats: 4 sets x 5 reps @ 80% 1RM (focus on explosive concentric phase)
- Romanian Deadlifts: 3 sets x 8 reps (strengthening glutes and hamstrings for running stride)
- Heavy Sandbag Carries (70kg): 3 sets x 50 meters (core stability and breathing control under load)
- Kettlebell Swings (20kg): 3 sets x 15 reps (hip hinge power development)
- Core: Plank variations 3 sets x 1 min
priority_1.reason: You have already completed an aerobic cycling session today. A dedicated strength session will target neuromuscular adaptations, building the cycling torque needed for 5-min/20-min power and the structural durability required for a faster 5km running pace, all without adding excessive aerobic fatigue.

priority_2.workout_details:
- Warm-up: 15 mins easy Zone 2 running, followed by 3x 30-second strides
- Main Set: 5x 3-minute intervals @ target 5km pace (Zone 5 HR), with 3 minutes of walking/slow jogging recovery between intervals
- Cool-down: 10 mins easy jog and mobility stretching
priority_2.reason: This is a direct, high-intensity quality session targeting your 5km running pace goal. Your recovery metrics (TSB -7.8, HRV 56 ms) indicate you are fully cleared for high-intensity work, making this a perfect opportunity to stimulate VO2max adaptation.

priority_3.workout_details:
- Duration: 45-50 minutes
- Pace: Strictly maintain a conversational pace, keeping heart rate below 145 bpm
- Terrain: Flat, predictable surface (road or track) to minimize joint impact
priority_3.reason: If you are feeling any residual muscular tightness from today's cycling session, opting for a pure Zone 2 aerobic run maintains the 70% aerobic base requirement of your pyramidal training structure while safely stimulating cardiovascular adaptations and recovery.
